title: Ion Wastes: Cooperative Rescue

foundation.history: A forgotten drifting relay station once protected shielded relay coils, until recurring electromagnetic storms forced residents to abandon it.

premise: Ena Rene, a responder, must coordinate multiple rescue teams, relying on role synchronization despite electromagnetic storms.
central_conflict: a cascading emergency threatens the drifting relay station by restricting shielded relay coils.

plot_beats.name: Discovery
plot_beats.cause: electromagnetic storms destroys the primary approach
plot_beats.effect: The player must choose an alternative entry

plot_beats.name: Competing truths
plot_beats.cause: a cascading emergency contests access to shielded relay coils
plot_beats.effect: The protagonist must reconcile independent testimony

plot_beats.name: Reconstruction
plot_beats.cause: The drifting relay station becomes operable
plot_beats.effect: The choice of stewardship rewrites the alliance map

endings.consequence: Open council administers shielded relay coils
Locals create an autonomous stewardship cooperative
Survival is proven but structural inequity remains
